subject: Mobile Development
title: What Is a Walled Garden?
description: Learn What Is a Walled Garden? in one minute.

hook.text: Apple decides what apps you can install, how they look, and what they're allowed to do.

buildup.text: Every iOS app must pass Apple's review. Apps that break rules are rejected or removed.

discovery.text: This control ensures quality and security but limits user freedom.

twist.text: Apple banned entire categories: porn, gambling in some regions, and apps that compete with iOS.

climax.text: The walled garden is Apple's greatest strength and its biggest antitrust liability.

punchline.text: Safety and control are two sides of one wall.

quiz.question: What is Apple's walled garden?
options: Apple's tight control over what apps can be on iOS
